# Bounce

A tribute to the classic Nokia *Bounce*. Roll a ball through eight brick levels,
jump through every ring to open the exit gate, and keep clear of the thorns.

## Gameplay

- **Rings** - roll or jump through the middle of every ring in the level. When the last one is collected, the exit gate opens.
- **Checkpoints** - touch a flag and you respawn there after losing a ball.
- **Springs** - launch the ball about five tiles into the air.
- **Water** - the ball floats. Hold Down to dive, then jump at the surface to leap clear.
- **Spikes and spikers** - a single touch pops the ball. Spikers patrol either left and right or up and down.
- **Hearts** - an extra ball.

You start with three balls. Unlocked levels, your best score and the sound
setting are saved between sessions.

## Controls

- **Left** and **Right** - roll
- **Up** or **OK** - jump, hold to keep bouncing
- **Down** - dive while in water
- **Back** - pause, with resume, restart level and title screen

On the title screen, Left and Right pick any unlocked level, Up and Down switch
between the level and sound options, and Back exits the game.

## Levels

Eight hand-built levels, unlocked in order: First Bounce, Thorns, Spring Tower,
Spikers, The Climb, Deep Water, Spike Alley and Grand Finale.
